modes.title: Game modes
modes.subtitle: Choose the challenge that suits you

classico.name: Classic
classico.desc: 5 rounds across the entire world, no time limit. The original mode.

sprint.name: Sprint
sprint.desc: 60 seconds per round. Maximum adrenaline, no hesitation.

paese.name: Country
paese.desc: Guess only the country, not the exact location. Easier.

italia.name: Italy Only
italia.desc: Explore only Italian roads and landscapes. For patriots.
